svg.title: A dependency graph does not record source cancellation
svg.desc: For four differences Zi-Z(i-1), collecting source coefficients leaves -1 on Z0, +1 on Z4, and zero on all internal sources. For four centered sums Zi+Z(i-1)-1, the internal source coefficients are two. Both processes have the same path dependency graph and node marginals. The exact variance of their means is respectively 1/(2n^2) and (4n-2)/(4n^2).
